summary:
FinTwit swing-trading work-up as of 2026-10-06. Access notes: WebSearch budget (200) was fully used; X mirrors (xcancel.com, nitter) returned HTTP 451/DNS failures; reddit.com/old.reddit.com are blocked for this tool, redlib mirrors failed, and the pullpush Reddit API rate-limited (429); YouTube channel pages returned only footers; traderlion.com, tradersunion.com, invezz.com and citadelsecurities.com returned 403. So X content is verified only via ThreadReader (Kobeissi, 2025-10-17) and secondary write-ups that quote the traders; YouTube is covered via podcast/notes pages that reference specific videos. Everything attributed below has a URL; where I could not reach the primary post I marked confidence low/medium.

What the most-cited swing traders actually trade converges on a small set of setups: (1) momentum breakouts from tight flags/VCPs in stocks that already moved 30-100%+ (Qullamaggie, Minervini, Zanger, Kell); (2) catalyst gap-ups in neglected stocks, called Episodic Pivots (Pradeep Bonde, popularized by Qullamaggie), Power Earnings Gaps (traderstewie) or Buyable Gap-Ups (IBD/Morales-Kacher); (3) short-horizon 3-5 day momentum bursts off 4% range-expansion days (Stockbee); (4) parabolic shorts/longs after 3-5+ straight days up (Qullamaggie); (5) pullback entries to the 5/10/20-day EMA or an anchored VWAP (Shannon, Kell's EMA Crossback, Burns). The shared mechanics are: enter on opening-range high, stop at low of day (never wider than the stock's ADR/ATR), sell 1/3-1/2 into strength after 3-5 days, trail the rest on the 10- or 20-day MA, and only press when breadth/"situational awareness" says breakouts are working.

Tools they name: TC2000 (Stockbee scans and Market Monitor; Qullamaggie-style ADR/1-3-6-month scans), TradingView (Shannon's AVWAP work, Qullamaggie's SMA 10/20 script, many community indicators), MarketSmith/MarketSurge (Minervini Trend Templates, IBD EPS/RS lines), Deepvue (co-founded 2022 by Richard Moglen, Ross Haber et al.; RS line vs SPY, EPS/RS ratings, industry-group ranks, 'Deepvue Terminal' AI added late 2025), Finviz (general), Stockbee's members Market Monitor, and Minervini Private Access tooling (MAI, MonAlert, TradeGrader).

Regime: 2025 was a V-shaped tariff crash (Apr 2-9) into a strong momentum run; a 12-month top-100-winners study found ~60% of clean Qullamaggie-style breakouts clustered July-Oct 2025 (AI/data-center, semis, biotech, precious metals). 2026 has been harder: a five-week rout into a Nasdaq correction by 2026-03-27 (oil >$110 on Iran conflict, Fed guiding one cut, 10-yr 4.44%), a Fundstrat/Newton 'bottoming process' call 2026-04-07, then a narrow AI-led rally with poor breadth (Sept 2026: equal-weight S&P -4.8%, Russell 2000 -5.3%, Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on Sept 15-16, 10-yr to 5.29%, Nasdaq 50 new highs vs 461 new lows on Sept 28). Retail/0DTE influence is at records (0DTE = 48% of retail options volume per Kobeissi, 2026-07-05; ~78% of NDX options volume, 2026-02-11; margin debt $1.23T record Dec 2025).

methods.name: Qullamaggie Momentum Breakout (flag / high-tight-flag out of tight consolidation)
methods.description: Kullamägi's own words (qullamaggie.com): scan for 'the 1 or 2% of stocks that are up the most over these 3 timeframes: 1-month, 3-month, 6-month'; look for a big prior move, an orderly pullback with higher lows and tightening range around rising 10/20-day MAs, then range expansion. Entry: 'Enter on the opening range highs... the highs of the first 1-minute candle, the 5-minute candle or the 60-minute candle.' Stop: 'always lows of the day and stop should not be wider than the ATR or ADR.' Exit: 'sell 1/3 to 1/2 of the position after 3-5 days, and then move the stop to break even. The rest of the position should be trailed with the 10- or the 20-day moving average.' Community-documented scan parameters (Tikam Singh Alma, 2024-04-05): ADR% > 5, price +25% vs 22 days ago, +50% vs 67 days, +150% vs 126 days, within 15% of 6-day high/low, Volume x Close > $3M, listed only. Stream notes (June 2023): uses simple 10/20 SMAs, price and volume only; 'Stories are way more powerful than fundamentals'; 'never read financial media again.' Study (FinancialWisdomTV, published Aug 2026, 12-month window): 58 of the top-100 performers had a clean 5-star breakout; avg initial risk ~3%, avg return ~62%, R:R >20:1; ~60% of setups occurred July-Oct 2025, fewer in Apr-May 2026.
proponents: @Qullamaggie (Kristjan Kullamägi) on X; qullamaggie.com; YouTube/Twitch streams (420+ archived streams reviewed by Retail Trader's Repository substack)
Tikam Singh Alma, The Philomath Chronicle (Substack)

methods.name: Episodic Pivot (EP) / catalyst gap-up in a neglected stock
methods.description: Term coined by Pradeep Bonde (Stockbee, 2010 blog post; revived by pupil Qullamaggie). Qullamaggie's version: 'Gap up 10%+', 'Big volume', big earnings/revenue beat, stock has NOT rallied in the prior 3-6 months; entry at opening-range high (1/5/60-min), stop at low of day, trail with 10/20-day MA; he rates EP/breakout R:R at 30-50x vs 5-10x for parabolic shorts. Bonde's rules (F4VS write-up, 2024-09-19): MAGNA = Massive Acceleration in profit growth (double/triple digit or huge beat), Gap up on the news, Neglected for 2 months-3 years, Acceleration in sales growth; optional '53' = 5+ days short interest and 3+ analysts raising targets; 'Cap10 x 10IPO' = small cap ($10-100M preferred) and IPO within 10 years for explosive variants. Entry at open or after a few minutes' shakeout; 'Delayed Reaction' entry next day if hesitation. Stop 2.5% standard (up to 10% for anticipated triple-digit moves). Sub-setups: '9 Million EP' (neglected stock trading 9M+ shares) and 'Sugar Babies'. Expected 70% win rate and 10-12 classic EPs/year in good markets, 3-4 in choppy ones. Tradingsim (updated 2026-03-31) general rules: gap 8-10%+, 2-3x volume arriving pre-market/first 30 min; entries via 5-min ORB (stop = intraday low), flag/wedge consolidation, or pullback risking 3-4% below gap low (Morales 'porosity rule'); trail 10/20/50-day MA, sell 1/3-1/2 at +20% or 3-5 days. Bonde is still running EP bootcamps (Las Vegas, Nov 13-15, 2026, posted 2026-09-17).
proponents: @PradeepBonde (Pradeep Bonde / Stockbee) on X; stockbee.blogspot.com; Stockbee members site

methods.name: Parabolic Short (and parabolic long reversal)
methods.description: Qullamaggie (own site): 'A stock up 50-100%+ in a few days or weeks' (large caps) or '300-1000%+' (small caps), 'up 3-5+ days in a row.' Entry: 'Short on the opening range lows (1-minute, 5-minute candles). You can wait for the first red 5-minute candle,' or the stock cracks, bounces to VWAP and fails. Stop: 'Highs of the day or if VWAP fail, a reclaim of the VWAP.' Target: 'The 10- and 20-day moving averages.' He calls it a 5-10x R:R setup vs 30-50x for breakouts/EPs. Stonks Capital (Niv Goren, 2025-02-10) systematized it: 'Patience is your edge. Let the early shorts get burned'; backtest from 2007: 1,869 trades, CAGR 27.7%, max DD -20.9%; tight stops beat wide stops, profit targets made negligible difference.

methods.name: Stockbee Momentum Burst / 4% breakout (3-5 day swing)
methods.description: Pradeep Bonde (F4VS write-up, 2024-09-25): stocks move in 3-5 day bursts of 8-20% (sometimes 8-40%); catch range expansion at the start, not after. Entry checklist '2LNCH': not up 2 days in a row already; trades Linearly (not choppy); Negative or Narrow day before the breakout; orderly Consolidation with low volume/volatility contraction; Close near the high on entry day. For consolidations >10 days add a Catalyst and Volume 1.5-2x the 50-day average. Universe: >$100 stocks for smooth moves, or <$1B small caps in biotech/tech/consumer; market cap under $10B. Scans: daily stocks up/down 20%+ in 5 days; weekly up 50%+ in 2 months. The 4% breakout scan in TC2000 (community formula): (100*(C-C1)/C1) >= 4 AND V >= 1000 AND V > V1; a 'Breakout 1M Base' scan credited to @PradeepBonde: close/close(1) >= 1.04, volume > 200k, 50-day $volume > $2M, close in top 30% of range, within 10% of 21-day high/low. 'Situational awareness': Stockbee Market Monitor tracks counts of 4%+ up vs down days and 10-day ratios; green columns = breakouts likely to work, red = stand aside ('FFM = find situational awareness where you can find free money'). Advice: 'Copy shamelessly', then 'study 5,000, 6,000, 10,000 breakouts before you put $1 on' the strategy.
proponents: Stockbee scan reproductions on TradingView/TC2000 (LuxAlgo library, tradermonty 'claude-trading-skills', fintwits scans index by @LignoL23)

methods.name: Minervini VCP (Volatility Contraction Pattern) + Trend Template (SEPA)
methods.description: Mark Minervini (3x US Investing Champion; @markminervini). VCP: a Stage-2 uptrend stock bases with 2-4 successive contractions, each tighter than the last (textbook example 15% -> 10% -> 5%, each ~20-30% smaller), volume dries up on pullbacks (to ~40-60% of 50-day average) and expands on the breakout (140-150%+); buy via buy-stop 1-2% above the pivot (high of the final contraction); entries within 5% of pivot had ~40% better R:R than late entries (Finer Market Points checklist, 2026-01-26, updated 2026-03-10). Checklist also requires RS rating 70+ (ideally 90+), accelerating quarterly EPS growth 20%+ (prefer 25%+), and a bullish general market, noting 'market conditions alone can influence success rates by more than 50%.' Trend Template (as used in MarketSmith/MarketSurge, Reports > Stocks > Technical): price above 50/150/200-day MAs, 150 > 200, 200-day rising for at least 1 month (ideally 4-5 months; 'non-negotiable for Mark'), 30%+ above 52-week low, within 25% of 52-week high, RS 70+. His services: Minervini Private Access (real-time buys/sells, market commentary), 2025 and 2026 workshops, 'Minervini AI (MAI)', MonAlert, TradeGrader, TradingLogger. 2026 commentary (Traders Union summary, not directly fetched): rotation defines the 2026 bull market; frequent leadership shifts reduce index volatility and make stock selection critical.
proponents: @markminervini on X; minervini.com / Minervini Private Access
IBD / MarketSurge (Minervini Trend Template screens, IBD Live appearances)
Finer Market Points (Christopher Hall) checklist write-up

methods.name: Oliver Kell Cycle of Price Action (Wedge Pop, EMA Crossback, Base n' Break, Exhaustion Extension, Wedge Drop)
methods.description: Oliver Kell (2020 US Investing Champion, +941%). Framework is fractal across timeframes and uses the 10/20 EMA stack plus 50/200 SMA. Phases: Reversal Extension (capitulation low), Wedge Pop ('a stock first trades up through the moving averages after reaching a downside extension' — Kell's 'money pattern'), EMA Crossback (low-risk pullback entry to the 10/20 EMAs after trend confirmation), Base n' Break (consolidation then breakout; downside version for shorts), Exhaustion Extension (price far above 10 EMA on climactic volume), Wedge Drop ('the first time a stock trades down through the moving averages after reaching an upside extension'). Sell rule from Moglen interview (2021-10-15): a stock extended from the 10 EMA on both daily and weekly charts needs to consolidate; 'Volume = Price, Cause = Effect' — heavy volume at breakouts shows institutions, heavy volume when extended shows churning/distribution. Taught via TraderLion 'Price Cycle Mastery'/'Oliver Kell Full Strategy Masterclass' produced with Richard Moglen.
proponents: @RichardMoglen (Trading Engineered Substack; TraderLion; Market Chat Podcast)

methods.name: Anchored VWAP pullback / multi-timeframe trend alignment (Brian Shannon)
methods.description: Brian Shannon, CMT (@alphatrends; books 'Technical Analysis Using Multiple Timeframes' 2008 and 'Maximum Trading Gains with Anchored VWAP' 2023). Anchor AVWAP at meaningful events: high-volume days (1.5x normal), earnings/Fed announcements, swing highs/lows, significant gaps, IPO price, year/quarter start. Price above a rising AVWAP = buyers in control from that anchor; below a falling one = sellers; oscillating = undecided. Entry rule: do not buy the first touch of AVWAP on a dip, wait for 'some strength after the dip'; stop at the low of the dip (long) or high of the bounce (short). Multi-timeframe: 'Start with the long-term timeframe to determine overall money flows; then move to intermediate term to plan the trade and finally consult the short-term chart to fine-tune entries and exits'; at least three timeframes should agree. Swing setup: price above rising 5-day MA + above AVWAP + above longer MAs; look for pullbacks to the 5-day MA in trending names. Mantras: 'Only price pays', risk management is 'Job One'. March 27, 2025 MoneyShow podcast titled 'Stop Buying the Dip, Start Doing This Instead' argues blind dip-buying is a losing swing strategy. Tools: TradingView (he publishes AVWAP scripts there), alphatrends.net.
proponents: @alphatrends (Brian Shannon) on X; alphatrends.net; TradingView scripts

methods.name: Power Earnings Gap (PEG) / Buyable Gap-Up / Earnings Gap Hold
methods.description: PEG was popularized by @traderstewie (per TradingSim); the 'Buyable Gap Up' label is Gil Morales/Chris Kacher (IBD lineage). Common PEG definition: gap/gain of 10%+ on earnings, volume >200% of the 50-day average, EPS surprise 20%+. Trade plan: either buy the opening-range breakout (stop = intraday low) or wait for a no-wick-top long green candle and then a 2-5 day tight flag/pennant near the gap high with declining volume; buy the break with volume; stop below the midpoint of the gap-day range; first target 8-12% (TradeZella, 2026-03-31, which also suggests 50-75% of normal size for this setup); trail with 10/20/50-day MA; IBD-style violation rule = close below the MA AND below the low of the candle that first violated it. Enduring reference: Qullamaggie's EP rules are the same family.
proponents: @traderstewie (Trader Stewie, 'The Art of Trading') on X

methods.name: Dan Zanger high-volume chart-pattern breakouts (cup & handle, high tight flag, flat base, ascending triangle)
methods.description: Dan Zanger (@DanZanger; chartpattern.com; audited $10,775 -> $42M in 23 months, 1998-2000). Core: 'Price + Volume' is all you need; no indicators. Cup and handle rule (CMC 'Opto' interview): the handle must start up near the old highs, not halfway up the cup; avoid cups that are 'halfway on one side and all the way up on the other.' Buys breakouts only with a volume surge, avoids buying more than ~5% above the breakout, exits immediately if price falls back into the pattern, takes partial profits (20-30% of position) at +15-20%, concentrates in sector leaders in strong bull markets, avoids margin until deeply experienced (the '10 Golden Rules' list is a third-party summary of a YouTube video — treat the exact wording as low confidence). The Zanger Report is a nightly newsletter of breakouts/commented charts plus a members chatroom.
proponents: Tradecraft/skillsmp summary (secondary; sourced from a 'Dollar Wisdom' YouTube video)

methods.name: IBD CAN SLIM / Market School regime filter (Follow-Through Day, distribution days, exposure levels)
methods.description: IBD (@IBDinvestors; MarketSmith rebranded MarketSurge). Market Pulse states: Confirmed Uptrend / Uptrend Under Pressure / Market in Correction (green/yellow/red), expanded in Market School into five exposure levels (% of portfolio invested). Follow-Through Day: on day 4-7 (some versions 4-10) of a rally attempt, a major index gains ~1.7%+ on volume higher than the prior day; 'no raging bull has ever started without one.' Distribution day: index down (non-trivial) on higher volume than the prior day; a cluster of 5-6 within ~25 sessions signals institutional selling; distribution days expire after ~5 weeks. Stock side: buy proper bases (cup-with-handle, flat base, double bottom) at the pivot, 7-8% max loss, RS line at new highs, EPS line overlay (MarketSurge). Tools: MarketSurge, IBD Live, Deepvue (built by TraderLion alumni to apply CANSLIM-style screens).
proponents: Deepvue (Richard Moglen, Ross Haber, Ameet Rai, Nicholas Schmidt; founded 2022)

methods.name: 10/20-EMA (and 5-day) pullback / mean reversion to the 20 EMA in a trending leader
methods.description: Shared by several camps: Kell's 'EMA Crossback' (pullback to the 10/20 EMA stack after trend confirmation), Shannon's 5-day-MA pullback in strong trends, Steve Burns (2012 interview: favors stocks above the 5-day EMA, buys pullbacks to the 10-day EMA, uses the 200-day on SPY as the market filter, 'never risk more than 1% of your total capital on any one trade', trailing stops to exit). TradeZella's 2026 version: stock above 200 EMA, price within 2% of the 20 EMA, RSI 40-55, low-volume pullback, reversal candle; stop below the reversal candle low or 1.5% below the 20 EMA; target the prior swing high; exit if two consecutive closes below the 20 EMA; expected win rate 55-65%. Qullamaggie uses the same MAs for exits, not entries ('trail with the 10- or 20-day moving average').

methods.name: Jesse Stine 'Insider Buy Superstocks' (weekly-chart superstock with 10-week 'magic line')
methods.description: Jesse Stine (@JesseStine; book 'Insider Buy Superstocks', record $46K -> $6.8M, 14,972% in 28 months). Weekly-chart method: look for a stock breaking out above its 30-week moving average after a long base, with a fundamental 'super' catalyst (earnings inflection), low float, and insider buying; after the breakout the 10-week MA ('magic line') acts as support where you add; sell when it loses the magic line or goes parabolic/climactic. Runs 'Friends and Family Market Alerts' on jessestine.com. Niche but frequently cited on FinTwit as an enduring classic; no 2025-2026 dated commentary could be retrieved.

methods.name: Trader Stewie 'Art of Trading' discretionary swing (wedges, breakouts, pullbacks, PEGs)
methods.description: Trader Stewie (Basim; @traderstewie), trading since 1998 and full-time since 2004; known on FinTwit for wedge breakouts, flag breakouts and for popularizing the Power Earnings Gap label. Sells 'The Art of Trading – Inside the Mind of Trader Stewie' (225+ page interactive PDF, 60+ min video) covering chart patterns (flags, head-and-shoulders, double tops/bottoms), breakouts/pullbacks/reversals as triggers, reward-to-risk and dynamic stops, volatility-adjusted position sizing and 'Unbreakable Rules' such as 'Trade Your Plan Every Time' and 'Keep Setups Simple'. A 2008-era interview summary claims he 'never uses stop losses' and puts himself on 'trading probation' — low confidence and possibly outdated. Could not retrieve his X feed directly.

methods.name: TraderLion / Richard Moglen 'True Market Leaders' (RS-line leadership + Kell/O'Neil hybrid)
methods.description: Richard Moglen (@RichardMoglen; TraderLion co-host, Deepvue co-founder, co-author 'The Trader's Handbook', July 2025; 100+ trader interviews on The Market Chat Podcast and TraderLion Podcast incl. Stan Weinstein, Mark Ritchie II, Oliver Kell). Approach: identify True Market Leaders via relative strength (RS line vs SPY making new highs ahead of price), accelerating EPS/sales, top industry groups, then time entries with Kell's price cycle (wedge pop, EMA crossback) or base breakouts; manage with 10/20 EMA and progressive exposure keyed to market health. TraderLion YouTube 2025 examples: 'How to Find and Trade the Next Tesla – Swing Trading Strategy' (Jan 2025) and '433% Return in 1 Year: From Poker Player to Full-Time Trader' (Christian Flanders, Feb 2025). Deepvue screener provides RS/EPS ratings, industry group rank, RS line, and (late 2025) the 'Deepvue Terminal' AI assistant.
proponents: @RichardMoglen on X; Trading Engineered Substack; Market Chat Podcast

things_to_recognize: ADR% above 5 (Qullamaggie): only trade stocks whose average daily range is big enough that a low-of-day stop is small relative to the expected move; stop must never be wider than the ADR/ATR — https://tikamalma.substack.com/p/qullamaggie-swing-trading-setups and https://qullamaggie.com/my-3-timeless-setups-that-have-made-me-tens-of-millions/

Prior momentum first: the stock should already be up 30%+ (best cases 100%+) over 1-6 months and sit in the top 1-2% of performers before you look for a flag; the top-100-winners study found avg 3% risk vs ~62% return on such breakouts — https://www.financialwisdomtv.com/post/qullamaggie-breakout-setup-case-study-what-the-top-100-winning-stocks-reveal

Orderly consolidation with higher lows, tightening range and a surfing of the rising 10/20-day MAs; volume dries up in the base (Minervini: to ~40-60% of 50-day avg) and expands on the breakout (140-150%+ or 1.5-2x) — https://www.finermarketpoints.com/post/vcp-criteria-complete-checklist and https://retailtradersrepository.substack.com/p/pradeep-bonde-momentum-bursts

Opening-range high (1/5/60-minute) as the trigger and low-of-day as the stop; if the stock has already moved more than its ATR intraday, do not chase — https://qullamaggie.com/my-3-timeless-setups-that-have-made-me-tens-of-millions/

Episodic Pivot tells: 10%+ gap on huge volume (9M+ shares in a neglected name), after 3-6 months of neglect, on a real catalyst (sales growth acceleration, massive beat, new story); 'Stories are way more powerful than fundamentals' — https://retailtradersrepository.substack.com/p/pradeep-bonde-episodic-pivots and https://tradingresourcehub.substack.com/p/qullamaggie-stream-notes-1-june-2023

Stockbee '2LNCH' pre-breakout checklist: not up 2 days in a row, linear (non-choppy) trend, narrow/negative day before, orderly consolidation, close near the high on the breakout day — https://retailtradersrepository.substack.com/p/pradeep-bonde-momentum-bursts

VCP contraction sequence (e.g., 15% -> 10% -> 5%, 2-4 contractions, each ~20-30% smaller) with a clear pivot; buy within 5% of the pivot, never late — https://www.finermarketpoints.com/post/vcp-criteria-complete-checklist

Trend Template: 200-day MA rising for 4-5 months is 'non-negotiable' for Minervini; count of stocks passing the template is itself a market-health gauge — https://lilys.ai/en/notes/notebooklm-20251211/mark-minervini-trend-template-marketsmith

Parabolic exhaustion: 3-5+ consecutive up days with 50-100%+ (large cap) or 300-1000%+ (small cap) gains; wait for the opening-range low break or first red 5-minute candle; a failed VWAP reclaim is the confirmation; target is the 10/20-day MA — https://qullamaggie.com/my-3-timeless-setups-that-have-made-me-tens-of-millions/ and https://stonkscapital.substack.com/p/systemizing-kullamagis-parabolic

Kell cycle signals: 'Wedge Pop' = first trade back up through the 10/20 EMAs after a downside extension (buy); 'Wedge Drop' = first trade down through them after an upside extension (sell/short); extension from the 10 EMA on BOTH daily and weekly = time to expect consolidation — https://www.tradingview.com/script/GOkJ7o5J-Wedge-Pop-Drop-QuantVue and https://tradingengineered.substack.com/p/5-key-concepts-from-my-interview

Anchored VWAP posture: price above a rising AVWAP from the last major catalyst/low = buyers in control; a flat AVWAP = indecision; buy after strength returns post-dip, not at first touch; stop under the dip low — https://www.financialwisdomtv.com/post/maximum-trading-gains-using-price-time-volume
Multiple-timeframe agreement (weekly, daily, intraday) before taking a swing; Shannon requires at least three timeframes to line up — https://cmtassociation.org/?p=2451

Market-regime gates: IBD Follow-Through Day (day 4-7 of a rally, ~1.7%+ on higher volume) to re-enter; clustered distribution days to cut exposure; Stockbee Market Monitor green vs red columns (counts of 4%+ up vs down days, 10-day ratios) to decide whether breakouts are 'free money' or a trap — https://seekingalpha.com/instablog/195752-joshua-hayes/73173-a-quick-reminder-about-follow-through-days and https://retailtradersrepository.substack.com/p/pradeep-bonde-momentum-bursts

Breadth divergence as a warning: 2026-09-28 Nasdaq printed only 50 new 52-week highs vs 461 new lows (NYSE 16 vs 422) while the indexes sat near highs; equal-weight S&P fell 4.8% in September 2026 while cap-weight rose — https://investrade.com/market-review-september-28-2026/ and https://www.janushenderson.com/corporate/article/market-moves-themes-that-mattered-september-2026/

Clustered opportunity windows: ~60% of clean breakouts in the 12-month study occurred July-Oct 2025 and very few in Apr-May 2026 — size up only when setups are working, scale down when breakouts fail (Kullamägi: 'breakouts are not working well on this thing' as a reason to skip) — https://www.financialwisdomtv.com/post/qullamaggie-breakout-setup-case-study-what-the-top-100-winning-stocks-reveal and https://retailtradersrepository.substack.com/p/qullamaggie-stream-46-50-review

Theme/sector rotation read via price and volume only ('Is it going up on big volume? Or no?'); 2025-26 leaders cited: AI/data centers, semiconductors, biotech, precious metals, uranium, quantum — https://tradingresourcehub.substack.com/p/qullamaggie-stream-notes-1-june-2023 and https://www.financialwisdomtv.com/post/qullamaggie-breakout-setup-case-study-what-the-top-100-winning-stocks-reveal

Power Earnings Gap filter: 10%+ gain, volume >200% of 50-day average, EPS surprise 20%+, volume arriving pre-market/first 30 minutes, gap holds and forms a 2-5 day flag — https://tradingsim.com/blog/episodic-pivot-power-earnings-gap-buyable-gap-up-explained/ and https://www.tradezella.com/blog/swing-trading-strategies

Sell discipline common to all camps: take 1/3-1/2 off into strength after 3-5 days (or at +20%), move stop to breakeven, trail the remainder on the 10- or 20-day MA; IBD-style violation = close below the MA and below the low of the candle that first broke it — https://qullamaggie.com/my-3-timeless-setups-that-have-made-me-tens-of-millions/ and https://tradingsim.com/blog/episodic-pivot-power-earnings-gap-buyable-gap-up-explained/
